claims.text: Many reviewers love the lashes, describing them as beautiful, dramatic, and high quality, and plan to repurchase.
Several reviewers praise the lashes for being lightweight and comfortable to wear.
Some reviewers report inconsistency, with pairs not matching each other or differing in shape and length.
A few reviewers find the lash band stiff, inflexible, or plastic-like, making application difficult.
Some reviewers highlight durability, noting pairs last a long time through repeated wear.
